name: social0
description: Orchestration scripts only — frontend and backend stay separate packages (Pages deploys frontend/ alone).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend/server & npm run dev --prefix backend/background-worker & npm run dev --prefix frontend & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.typecheck:backend: npm run build --prefix backend/shared && npx --prefix backend tsc -p backend/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
